annotations.title: Countries With The Best Travel Weather

description: List the N countries where the weather is best for travelling by campervan, highest 0-100 travel score first: today's score by default, or with period=week the score of the coming 7 days (the ranking used on OpenVan.camp). Use it when no country is named and someone asks where to go for warm or good weather right now — worldwide or in a region (region=europe…); with sort=warmest only when they literally ask where it is warmest or hottest (it ranks by temperature alone, so deserts come first; «warm and pleasant», «warm and dry» → the default score). These are today's conditions and the coming days, not a forecast for a later month: for «in November» say so.

limit.description: How many top-scoring countries to return.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

period.description: today = today's score (default, «right now»); week = the score of the coming 7 days, the ranking used on OpenVan.camp — for «this week», «the coming days», «where to go next week».

region.description: Only countries of this region — «best weather in Europe». asia includes the Middle East; cis = Russia, the Caucasus and Central Asia. Default: world.

sort.description: score = best overall travel weather (default, also for «warm and pleasant»); warmest = highest daytime temperature today — only for a literal «where is it warmest/hottest».
